description: Use when an agent must receive a verification email (sign-up, login code, magic link) without a mailbox. Input: none. Output: address @inbox.1gateway.dev, id, one-time secret, read URL. Reads are free (header x-inbox-secret): sender, subject, text, with verification codes and confirmation links extracted. Receive only; 20 messages, 256 KB each, attachments dropped; deleted after 24 h. Some sites refuse new domains: not refunded. Example: GET /v1/agent/inbox Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: agent_inbox
title: Agent email inbox: a throwaway receive-only address for sign-up verification mail, codes and links pulled out, 24 h
